anchor: cut #3, after refusal #2 (gate-prep-16, O:2091), U3: the QUOTE_CONTROLS table was bound by id and finding count only, so a control re-pointed at an unrelated passing case left the census green; this fixture, outside the census, binds each control to its plant; cut #4, after refusal #3 (gate-prep-13, O:2120), U1 and U2: the census's QUOTES PLANTS reading binds every control listed here, and the QUOTES PLANTS controls it runs over planted mismatches are listed here too, each bound to its plant; cut #5, after refusal #4 (gate-prep-15, O:2139; R-B590's enumerate-the-resolvable form), U1 and U2: the census's two QUOTES readings are pinned at the first position, the last and every position, and the eight controls cut #5 adds are listed here too, each bound to its plant, the QUOTES PLANTS positions they shift with them
format: controls lists every QUOTES control of the census and then every QUOTES PLANTS control, in the census's order, each with its plant's lines: '- ' and a line of the helper's leading comment (test/helpers/hyperunix-successor-gate-readers.ts) the plant removes, or '+ ' and a line it writes there, each edit's common leading and trailing lines dropped; or '= ' and an entry it plants: its catalog, its label in double quotes, a colon, a space and the entry written with the block's identifier on one line, then ' / ', the second identifier, a colon, a space and the entry written with that identifier. A sweep's lines open with 'tags' and its tags' names (a printable ASCII character as itself, any other character as U+ and its four hex digits), then its plant's lines with <tag> where each tag is written. A QUOTES PLANTS control's lines are its re-pointings, each '~ ' and the id of the QUOTES control it re-points, then the lines of the plant it is re-pointed at (a sweep's for <tag>), then its rewrites of this fixture, each '# ' and the position it rewrites, counted from 1, then 'id ', the id written there and its lines (no 'id' line when the rewrite removes the entry). A QUOTES PLANTS control's lines end with its whole-fixture writes (cut #5), each '* ', the part it writes ('id': every entry's id; 'line': every line of every entry), a space and the mark written after it.
